verdict.rationale: Godot has extensive first-party documentation for editor extensibility: EditorPlugin-based plugins that manipulate scenes/assets without reloading the editor, EditorScript for one-off automation via _run(), import plugins for custom asset pipelines, and EditorInterface for programmatic control of scenes/resources/windows. An Asset Library further shows a real ecosystem of community-built editor tools/plugins. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer accounts specifically validating plugin/automation workflows (community evidence covers language/engine quality generally but not editor-scripting specifics).
